_comment: Add an entry only when the finding is genuinely intentional, and say why.
unattached-component: SCR_BaseGameModeComponent classes no prefab in CRF or
COALITION-Lobby attaches. The six below are special/alternate gamemodes that
predate this check - they were already unattached when it was written and
have NOT been verified as intentional. If a mission prefab outside these two
repositories attaches them, they belong here permanently. If nothing does,
they are dead the same way CRF_ServerStatsManager was and should be fixed
CRF_CacheHuntGamemodeManager is a separate case from those six and IS
verified as intentional. Gamemode components are attached per mission, on the
COA_Lobby entity in Worlds/<Map>/<Mission>_Layers/_INIT.layer - which is why
CRF_RushGamemodeManager passes the check and the others do not. Cache Hunt
shipped without a mission in this repository, so nothing attaches it yet.
Remove this entry as soon as the first Cache Hunt mission lands; after that
the check is meaningful for it again and the suppression would hide a real
